title: 4.1 Rooms at Home
unit_outcome: Locate familiar things and describe a short supported routine using known subjects, simple present chunks, days, and clock times.
goal: Recognize and name a home plus five familiar rooms using known identity frames.
grammar_function: This is the room; It is a home. No location prepositions yet.
prerequisite: Unit 2 place/object identities and demonstratives; Unit 3 supported self statements.

cards.pedagogy_note: introduces home; contrast with previously learned house as building
whole-home interior vs school; do not use house as a distractor because a house can also be a home
text hidden; conceptual distinction supported by whole interior
